description: Search the capture with the Hunt query language. Filters: body, contenttype, duration, encoding, host, is, method, mime, path, priority, protocol, referer, reqbody, respbody, scheme, size, status, time, type, url, or header.<name>. `is:` takes 1p, 3p, cached, failed, firstparty, http, https, redirect, thirdparty. Comparators (status:>=400, size:>500kb, duration:>1s), globs (host:*.doubleclick.net), regex (body:~/sk_live_[a-z0-9]+/), and negation (header.set-cookie:!secure) all work; bare words match the URL. Returns an `#` index — pass it to har_entry or har_curl.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to a .har file on this machine.
